mentions.name: Open-source AI visibility tool
mentions.description: A free, open-source (MIT-licensed) AI visibility tool with bring-your-own-API-key support. It tracks AI visibility by treating it as classical market research rather than as a Google Analytics 'AI edition' style analytics product.
mentions.problem: AI visibility is better approached as classical market research than as a 'GA AI Edition'-style analytics problem.
